name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
